title: You need to listen to the cosmic horror-comedy podcast Welcome to Night Vale
summary: It's relatively rare for a podcast to last 14 years, especially a fiction one. In fact, as far as I can tell, Welcome to Night Vale is the longest continually running fiction podcast out there.
